notes: Sheet runs from Broadway (west edge) to Lawrence (east edge), E. Pearl (top) to the river. Broadway is printed 100'; only its east face is drawn here (x about 435 at Pearl, 430 at 2nd, 410 at Front and Giffin), so the four Broadway points are placed 172 px (50 ft) west of that face, in the blank paper margin just inside the left edge. The Broadway water pipes are drawn east of centre on this sheet and were not used. Ludlow (66') slants NNW-SSE. North of E. Pearl it is only about 35 ft wide and offset about 50 px east, so the Pearl junction is recorded as two T points (south leg x 1830, north leg x 1878). Ludlow ends at Giffin. E. Front is straight from Broadway (where it bends to run E-W on sheet 104) ENE to Lawrence, with a 3-degree angle at Ludlow. E. 2nd and E. Front converge east of the wedge block (tip about x 3045, y 1775) and run into a single opening about 55 ft wide at Lawrence, so 2nd is recorded as ending in Front (Y-merge where the two centrelines meet, just west of Lawrence) and the Lawrence crossing is recorded once, as E. Front, which continues east onto sheet 106. Lawrence/Giffin lies about 40 px from the right paper edge and Lawrence's east face is off the sheet, so it is approximate; per sheet 106 it is an L-corner (Giffin ends at Lawrence and Lawrence ends at Giffin's south line). The unnamed alley (ALLE[Y] label, no width printed) runs from Ludlow WSW, passes under the viaduct approach, and reaches Broadway as a narrow passage (about 10 ft) south of the Benjamin Hey shoddy mill (IRON CLAD ONE SIDE ONLY). It meets Broadway at sheet 104's y 1373. Grade-separated crossings of the viaduct approach and the steel railroad trestle along Giffin are not recorded.
